html:
A BBC feature on how the MP3 came about, in which its inventor, Professor Karlheinz Brandenburg of the Fraunhofer Institute, tells the story himself. Fanyu Meng recommends it not least for Brandenburg’s irresistible German-accented English.

The story continues in part 2.

Video: BBC, via Guitars AI; shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
